entities.name: Ibn Jazla
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu Ali Yahya ibn Isa ibn Jazla al-Baghdadi or Ibn Jazlah, Latinized as Buhahylyha Bingezla, was an 11th-century Arab physician of Baghdad and author of an influential treatise on regimen that was translated into Latin in 1280 AD by the Sicilian Jewish physician Faraj ben Salem.
